name: RadioGroup
description: Lets the user pick exactly one option from a small, visible set. Use with Radio children.

description.description: Help text shown under the options.

errorMessage.description: Shown when the group is invalid.

isInvalid.description: Marks the group as invalid and shows errorMessage.

isRequired.description: Requires a selection for form submission.

onChange.description: Called with the newly selected value.

keyboard: Tab enters and leaves the group
requirements: Only the selected radio is in the tab order
screenReader: Entering the group announces the group label
Each option: radio button, its label, checked state and position (2 of 3)
Arrow keys announce the newly selected option

use_when: 2 to 6 mutually exclusive options that should all be visible
anti_patterns: A single radio on its own
No option selected when a sensible default exists

Passing isInvalid for required or format checks (even isInvalid={false}): any defined value takes over validity and hides the built-in errors. Use isRequired and validate; pass isInvalid only for errors the app finds itself, such as from the server
